items.title: 3.4 Solution of Equations Reducible to the Quadratic Equation (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum bachon! Ab tak aap ne quadratic equation \(ax^{2} + bx + c = 0\) ko factorisation, completing the square aur quadratic formula se hal karna seekha hai. Aaj ka sabaq ek nayi baat sikhata hai: kuch equations dekhne mein quadratic nahin lagtin, kisi mein variable denominator (neeche wala hissa) mein baitha hai, kisi mein square root ke andar chhupa hai, lekin thore se jaiz (legal) qadam uthayein to woh seedhi quadratic equation ban jati hain. Phir wahi purane tareeqe kaam aate hain jo aap pehle se jaante hain.

Kitab kehti hai: kuch equations aisi hain jo degree 2 ki nazar nahin aatin, lekin unhein quadratic equation mein reduce (tabdeel) kiya ja sakta hai. Hum rational, radical aur exponential equations ke solutions discuss karenge.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Ek baat pehle saaf kar doon: kitab ki is line mein teen qisam ki equations ka naam hai, lekin is unit mein sirf do qisam ki equations hal ki gayi hain: rational equations (3.4.1) aur radical equations (3.4.2). Exponential equation (jis mein variable power mein ho, jaise \(2^{x}\)) na is unit mein hal hui hai aur na Exercise 3.2 mein aati hai. Is liye aap ko sirf neeche wale do tareeqe pakke karne hain; pareshan hone ki zaroorat nahin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Pehle yaad karte hain ke hum kis cheez mein "reduce" kar rahe hain. Quadratic equation woh equation hai jis ki sab se bari power 2 ho aur jo is standard form (mayari shakal) mein likhi ja sake:
\[ax^{2} + bx + c = 0,\quad a \ne 0\]
Isay teen tareeqon se hal karte hain: factorisation (tukde karna), completing the square, ya neeche wala quadratic formula. "Reducible to a quadratic" ka matlab hai: equation shuru mein is shakal mein nahin hoti (variable denominator mein ho, square root ke andar ho, ya power 4 jaisi ho), lekin kuch sahi qadmon ke baad isi shakal mein aa jati hai. Yani asal kaam "shakal badalna" hai; hal karna to aap ko pehle hi aata hai.

blocks.text_alt: x equals minus b plus or minus the square root of b squared minus 4 a c, all over 2 a

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is poore hisse (3.4) ka ek hi plan hai. Ise zehan mein bitha lijiye, har sawal mein yahi chalega:
1. Sab se pehle restrictions (pabandiyan) likhein: koi denominator zero nahin ho sakta, aur square root ke andar wali expression negative nahin ho sakti. Kyun? Kyun ke zero se divide karna be-maani hai, aur negative number ka real square root hota hi nahin.
2. Mushkil hissa hatayein: rational equation mein dono sides ko common denominator (LCD) se multiply karein; radical equation mein ek radical ko akela kar ke dono sides ka square lein.
3. Simplify kar ke saare terms ek taraf le aayein, taa ke \(ax^{2} + bx + c = 0\) ban jaye.
4. Quadratic ko hal karein.
5. Jo values milein, unhein ASAL equation mein rakh kar check karein, aur jo value restriction toray ya equation ko satisfy na kare use reject kar dein.
Dhyan dein: step 5 marzi ka kaam nahin hai. Multiply karna aur square karna kabhi kabhi aisi values paida kar deta hai jo asal equation ka hal nahin hotin. Check na kiya to ghalat jawab bhi "sahi" lagega.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari apni misaal hai (kitab ka sawal nahin), sirf "reduce karna" ka idea samajhne ke liye. Equation lijiye: \(x^{4} - 5x^{2} + 4 = 0\). Is ki degree 4 hai, quadratic nahin lagti. Lekin ghor karein: \(x^{4} = (x^{2})^{2}\). To agar hum \(x^{2}\) ko ek naya naam de dein, \(y = x^{2}\), to equation ban jati hai:
\[y^{2} - 5y + 4 = 0\]
\[(y - 1)(y - 4) = 0\]
\[y = 1 \ \text{ya}\ y = 4\]
Ab wapas \(x\) par jayein (yeh qadam bohat se bache bhool jate hain): \(x^{2} = 1\) se \(x = \pm 1\), aur \(x^{2} = 4\) se \(x = \pm 2\). Solution set: \(\{-2, -1, 1, 2\}\). Tasdeeq ke liye \(x = 2\) rakhein: \(16 - 20 + 4 = 0\). Sahi! Dekha aap ne? Equation ka libaas badla, andar se quadratic hi nikli.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(x^{6} - 9x^{3} + 8 = 0\) ko quadratic banane ke liye aap kaun sa naya variable rakhenge? (Ishara: \(x^{6} = (x^{3})^{2}\). Jawab: \(y = x^{3}\), phir \(y^{2} - 9y + 8 = 0\).)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Kuch equations pehli nazar mein quadratic nahin hotin, lekin chand sahi qadmon ke baad quadratic ban jati hain.
2. Rational equation: LCD se multiply kar ke denominators khatam karein (3.4.1).
3. Radical equation: radical akela kar ke square karein (3.4.2).
4. Restrictions hamesha shuru mein likhein, aur har jawab asal equation mein check karein.
5. Is unit mein exponential equations hal nahin ki gayin, halaanke kitab un ka naam leti hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Quadratic ke roots nikaal kar ruk jana aur asal equation mein check na karna. Bachne ka tareeqa: har sawal ke aakhir mein "Check" ki line likhne ki aadat daalein.
2. Restrictions bhool jana: jo value denominator ko zero kare, ya square root ke andar negative number de, woh kabhi solution nahin ho sakti.
3. Naye variable (jaise \(y = x^{2}\)) mein jawab nikaal kar wahin chhor dena. Sawal \(x\) ka tha, to jawab bhi \(x\) mein dena hai.
